q: REFERENCE
note: An 8-year-old is about 1.3 m tall and about 26 kg.

q: How tall is a giraffe?
note: Big males reach 5.5 m; females grow up to about 4.3 m.

q: How tall is an African elephant at the shoulder?
note: Adult males are 2.9 to 3.7 m at the shoulder; females are shorter.

q: How long is a blue whale?
note: Most are 24 to 30 m long, about as long as two and a half school buses.

q: How long was a T. rex?
note: SUE, the biggest T. rex skeleton ever found, is over 12 m long.

q: How tall is a polar bear standing on its back legs?
note: A big male can stand 3 m tall, more than twice as tall as you.

q: How tall is an ostrich?
note: Males are 2.1 to 2.7 m tall. It is the tallest bird in the world.

q: How long is a saltwater crocodile?
note: Big males are 4.5 to 5 m long; rare giants grow past 6 m.

q: How tall is a moose at the shoulder?
note: A big bull can stand 2 m at the shoulder, taller than a horse, and its antlers stick up even higher.

q: How long is a green anaconda?
note: Most adults are up to 5 m long, and the females are much bigger than the males.

q: How tall is a grizzly bear standing on its back legs?
note: On all four legs it is only about 1 m tall at the shoulder.

q: How long is a great white shark?
note: Grown-up females are about 4.5 m long; males are smaller, and the biggest reach about 6 m.

q: How tall is a red kangaroo standing up?
note: A big male stands about 1.8 m tall; females are much smaller.

q: How tall is a gorilla standing on two legs?
note: Big males stand up to about 1.8 m, as tall as a grown man.

q: How wide are a Canada goose's wings, tip to tip?
note: Wingspans run from about 1.3 to 1.7 m, wider than you are tall.

q: How heavy is an African elephant?
note: Adult males average about 6,000 kg; females average about 2,800 kg.

q: How heavy is a blue whale?
note: The biggest weigh over 150 tonnes, as much as 25 African elephants.

q: How heavy is a hippo?
note: Adult males average about 1,500 kg, and big ones top 2,000 kg.

q: How heavy is a giraffe?
note: Males average about 1,200 kg; females average about 830 kg.

q: How heavy is a polar bear?
note: Adult males weigh 350 to 590 kg; females are about half that.

q: How heavy is a moose?
note: Big bulls weigh up to 600 kg in most of Canada; Alaska moose can reach 800 kg.

q: How heavy is a gorilla?
note: Adult males average about 140 kg, as heavy as 5 kids your age, and big ones top 200 kg.

q: How heavy is an ostrich?
note: Males weigh 100 to 130 kg. It is the heaviest bird alive.

q: How heavy was a T. rex?
note: Scientists estimate 7,000 to 9,000 kg, heavier than an African elephant.

q: How heavy is a beaver?
note: Adults weigh 16 to 32 kg, close to what you weigh! The beaver is a symbol of Canada.

q: How tall is the CN Tower?
note: 553 m to the tip of its antenna. It was the world's tallest free-standing structure for over 30 years.

q: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?
note: 330 m with its antennas. It grew 6 m in 2022 when a new antenna was added.

q: How tall is the Statue of Liberty, from the ground to the torch?
note: The statue is 46 m and stands on a pedestal that is just as tall.

q: How tall is the Burj Khalifa?
note: The world's tallest building, about one and a half CN Towers tall.

q: How tall is the Great Pyramid of Giza today?
note: It was about 147 m tall when it was built 4,500 years ago, but it lost its top stones.

q: How high is the drop at Niagara's Horseshoe Falls?
note: The water falls about 57 m, as high as a 19-storey building.

q: How tall is Mount Everest?
note: The highest mountain on Earth. It was measured again in 2020 at 8,848.86 m.

q: How long is a school bus?
note: A full-size school bus is about 12 m long, as long as 9 kids lying head to toe.

q: How long is an NHL hockey rink?
note: An NHL rink is 200 feet long and 85 feet wide, about 61 m by 26 m.

q: How long is a Boeing 747 jumbo jet?
note: The 747-400 is about 71 m long, longer than a hockey rink. The newer 747-8 is about 76 m.

q: How long was the Titanic?
note: About 269 m long, more than 4 hockey rinks end to end.

q: How tall is Hyperion, the world's tallest tree?
note: A coast redwood in California, taller than the Statue of Liberty.

q: How heavy is the Statue of Liberty?
note: It is made of copper and steel and weighs about 250 tonnes, as much as 40 elephants.

q: How heavy is the Eiffel Tower?
note: The iron frame weighs 7,300 tonnes; lifts, shops and antennas bring it to about 10,100.

q: How heavy is a school bus?
note: An empty full-size bus weighs about 7,000 to 10,000 kg, as much as 350 kids your age.

q: How heavy is a car?
note: A family car weighs about 1,500 kg; big SUVs and pickups weigh 2,000 kg or more.
